title: Bitcoin crashes to ~$62K, lowest since July, as $1.7B gets liquidated | Daily Brief
caption:
btc crashed to ~$62k on sunday, its lowest since early july 📉 eth ~$1,800 (-5%), sol ~$70 (-6%). $1.7b liquidated in 24h, ~80% longs. btc etfs: 7 straight outflow days, -$1.91b since nov 5. the driver: traders price an 88.5% chance of a december fed hike. this week: retail sales + nvidia tue, fed minutes wed. which level are you watching? not financial advice.
